id: title:benjackwhite:only require slack scopes on the fields that use them

review.posthog_relevance: Adds Slack destination permission enforcement and user-facing warnings for missing OAuth scopes, and backend HogQL checks to omit appearance fields when permissions are absent.
review.reason: The chunk P1.F5 and P1.F8 implements a substantive, bounded capability: distinguishing between connection-level and field-level permissions for Slack destinations. P1.F5.H1 adds a missing-scopes warning component and re-authorize link, while P1.F8.H5 adds HogQL checks and metadata to omit appearance fields when the required 'chat:write.customize' scope is missing. observations.behavior: Adds a missing-scopes warning component and its supporting hook, P1.F5 and P1.F6. P1.F5 renders a warning and a reconnect link; P1.F6 checks whether an input declares field-specific scopes and whether the connection has them.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows a Slack destination configuration to warn the user when the connection lacks the OAuth scopes required by a specific input field, and provides a link to re-authorize the connection.

observations.behavior: P1.F8 and P1.F9: P1.F8 removes the unconditional inclusion of icon_emoji and username, and P1.F9 adds the requiredScopes metadata. P1.F8 also adds HogQL checks to include these fields only when the connection has the chat:write.customize scope. P1.F9 adds the requiredScopes field to the HogFunctionInputSchemaType.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the Slack destination to distinguish between the connection-level permission and the field-level permission, and to omit the appearance fields when the connection lacks the required permission.
